args.final_thought:
Phase 1: Foundation & Shared Types is complete. All files already existed with correct implementations:

**Enums** (6 files in `src/shared/types/`):
- `leave-status.enum.ts` — LeaveStatus: DRAFT, SUBMITTED, APPROVED, REJECTED, CANCELLED
- `leave-type.enum.ts` — LeaveType: annual, sick, emergency, unpaid, maternity, paternity (lowercase string values)
- `leave-action.enum.ts` — LeaveAction: CREATE, SUBMIT, APPROVE, REJECT, CANCEL, UPDATE, DELETE
- `notification-type.enum.ts` — NotificationType: LEAVE_SUBMITTED, LEAVE_APPROVED, LEAVE_REJECTED, LEAVE_CANCELLED, BALANCE_UPDATED
- `employment-status.enum.ts` — EmploymentStatus: ACTIVE, INACTIVE, TERMINATED
- `audit-action.enum.ts` — AuditAction: CREATE, UPDATE, DELETE, APPROVE, REJECT

**Barrel export**: `src/shared/types/index.ts` re-exports all 6 enums using relative paths within the same directory.

**Error types**: `src/shared/error-types.ts` — NotFoundError (404), ValidationError (400), ConflictError (409), UnauthorizedError (401), all extending Error with `statusCode`.

**Base repository**: `src/shared/base-repository.ts` — `IBaseRepository<T>` interface with findById, findAll, create, update, delete (all accepting optional PoolClient); `BaseRepository<T>` abstract class importing the named `pool` export from `shared/db/connection` and implementing all methods.

**Tests**: `tests/unit/shared/types/enums.test.ts` — 13 tests verifying every enum value exists and has the correct count, importing from `shared/types` barrel.

**Verification**: `tsc --noEmit` passes cleanly (0 errors). All 13 Jest tests pass.
